item.title: Carl Cox Awarded OBE In King’s Birthday List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the music industry. Today, we're celebrating some amazing honors awarded to music legends. Let's get started!"
[Music transitions to a techno beat]
Host: "First up, the one and only Carl Cox has been named an Officer of the Order of the British Empire, or OBE, for his outstanding services to music. With a career spanning over four decades, Carl is a master of techno and house, and has performed on stages around the world."
[Clip of Carl Cox speaking] Carl Cox: "Music has been my life for as long as I can remember... To receive this honour for doing something that has brought me so much joy is truly humbling."
Host: "Carl expressed his gratitude to everyone who's been part of his journey, from fans to fellow artists, and the wider electronic music community. He's not the only one being recognized, though. Fellow British DJ Judge Jules, aka Julius O'Riordan, has been appointed a Member of the Order of the British Empire, or MBE, for his services to the music industry and young people."
[Clip of Judge Jules speaking] Judge Jules: "I've done an awful lot of mentoring... I go to the Brit School and lecture at least once or twice a year. It's one's absolute obligation to give back and to mentor, especially in the arts."
Host: "And finally, Black Sabbath guitarist Tony Iommi has also been made an MBE for his services to music and charity. These honors are awarded by the King, following recommendations by the prime minister or senior government ministers, to celebrate outstanding achievements and contributions to society."
[Music transitions back to intro music]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Congratulations to Carl Cox, Judge Jules, Tony Iommi, and all the other music legends being recognized for their amazing work. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
[Outro music plays]
